title: trailboss --json folders
description: Folders for a host's spaces, and the spaces filed by hand. Every `folders` action (add, edit, move, remove, file, unfile) prints this after it. Siblings show in the order listed.

parent.description: The folder it's in; null at the top.

color.description: ansi1 to ansi6 (Herdr's avatar colors), or null.

start.description: Where spaces made in it start, or null.

rules.description: `name` (a folder name anywhere in the path), `~/path/with/*` (that folder or below), or `machine:glob`.

spaces.description: Space id → folder id, or null for a space put at the top level on purpose. Spaces not listed are placed by rules (see `folders place`).
